Shared facilities centre on an infinity pool, a children's splash area and planted gardens, with sports courts, a running track and retail along the community promenade. description: Palm Central Private Residences is a Nakheel apartment and townhouse project on Palm Jebel Ali, spread over three low to mid-rise buildings in the middle of the island. Nakheel first released it in October 2025 and added a 222-home phase in June 2026.

Homes range from one-bedroom apartments to townhouses. Nakheel's price sheet starts at AED 2.7 million for a one-bedroom and gives an estimated construction completion of September 2030. Facilities include an infinity pool, padel and volleyball courts, a fitness studio, a clubhouse and children's play areas.

description: Bay Grove Residences is a Nakheel apartment development on Island B of Dubai Islands, off the Deira coast. Its final phase, announced in July 2025, adds four connected buildings with 257 homes, from one-bedroom apartments to four-bedroom units, plus a single penthouse.

The buildings share a podium with gardens, an infinity lap pool, a family pool, a clubhouse with a cinema room, a gym and indoor and outdoor children's areas. Residents can reach Crystal Beach directly. Nakheel does not publish prices, sizes, a payment plan or a handover date for this phase.
